Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

Face: wide triangular face; wide-set eyes and a low straight brow; small upturned nose, heavy lower lip; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: gray-white-silver, bob-pageboy, deliberate accent: hidden undercut. Wardrobe: short-jacket-trousers, specifically a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; visible hand repairs and contrasting inner edges; bounded palette plum-gray. Visible personal details: one clear birthmark. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a worn spool of colored thread only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
